title: Countries and currencies: ISO 3166-1 and ISO 4217
author: Claude (session https://claude.ai/code/session_01TA4id51RCSxZ4NxijDwrWQ), for owner review

items.statement: The DAK binds country to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (urn:iso:std:iso:3166) and currency to ISO 4217 (urn:iso:std:iso:4217). iHRIS's shipped lists stay as local CodeSystems (what deployments store), mapped by ConceptMaps country-to-iso-3166 and currency-to-iso-4217.
items.rationale: iHRIS's country record ids ARE ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (246 of 246) and its currency ids ARE ISO 4217 codes. Binding to the standard lets DAK consumers exchange data without an iHRIS-specific code system.

items.statement: Deployments still on the iHRIS 4.3.3 lists update them: add the current ISO codes that are missing (country: BQ, CW, SS, SX; currency: 38 codes, including ZMW, GHS, MRU, SSP), retire the withdrawn ones (country: AN; currency: 19 codes, including ZMK, GHC, MRO), and refresh the older names (11 countries, 15 currencies).
items.rationale: The lists date from 2009. The deltas are measured, not inferred: see iso-report.json. Which successor replaces a withdrawn currency in a deployment's historical records (e.g. ZMK amounts before 2013) is a data-migration decision the DAK cannot make.
